description: This file defines a Flutter page widget (BooksPage) that displays a list of books with functionalities such as search, pagination, and basic CRUD operations. It interfaces with an API client to fetch book data and displays it using Flutter UI components.

classes.name: BooksPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages and displays a paginated list of books with search and CRUD options.

classes.name: _BooksPageState
classes.description: The internal state class for BooksPage, handling data fetching, pagination, search, and UI rendering.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and loads the initial set of books.

methods.name: _loadBooks
methods.description: Fetches a list of books from the API, updating the state with results or errors.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the books listing UI, including search input, list items, and loading/error indicators.
